name: Meat and Frequency: The Chrome Review
creator: Solange Pietrzak-Nwosu
description: A twice-weekly neural-feed audio show dissecting new augmentation releases, geneware patches, and chrome modifications across all price tiers. Host Solange Pietrzak-Nwosu — a former HelixCorp product tester turned independent reviewer — is famous for her unsparing assessments of budget chrome marketed to Tier 2 workers, comparing manufacturer claims against lived performance data collected from her own body. She accepts no corporate sponsorship and funds the show through listener micro-payments in Quanta fractions.
medium: neural feed audio / offline audio cache
cultural_impact: One of the few augmentation review platforms that treats Tier 2 consumers as the primary audience rather than an afterthought, leading to several class-action complaints against chrome manufacturers who misrepresented compatibility specs.
controversy: HelixCorp filed a defamation suit in 2214 after Pietrzak-Nwosu's review of the Helix Synapse-7 budget BCI implant documented three cases of neural bleed in listeners who shared their medical logs with her; the suit was dropped quietly six months later.
story_hooks: A listener sends Pietrzak-Nwosu anonymous medical data proving a popular new chrome line causes delayed cognitive degradation — and someone wants that data suppressed before the review airs.
A Tier 4 chrome company offers Solange an enormous sum to give a positive review of a product she knows is dangerous for Tier 1-2 bodies; the negotiation itself gets leaked.
A bootleg version of the show begins circulating on the Shelf with the corporate-critical segments edited out — someone is systematically sanitizing the archive.
